Name: Windowed Borderless
Author: jbossjaslow
Description:
Forces the game into windowed borderless mode. Stardew sometimes has issues allowing this to be selected manually, so this mod force-enables it.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
This mod forces windowed borderless mode as soon as the game loads, so there is no need for you to do anything. However, if you need to manually switch to WBM anytime after the game loads, there is a keybind in the mod config

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.9
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. Most likely works in split-screen mode
[/list]
